name: fileinvite-lite
description: Root scripts so the whole prototype runs and checks with one command.

scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: dotnet build api/FileInviteLite.sln --nologo && dotnet test api/FileInviteLite.sln --nologo
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run test
